principle: A starship is simultaneously workplace, transport, emergency platform and—where applicable—home; off-duty life is constrained by the same authoritative time and location state as duty.
rules: Off-duty does not mean nonexistent; characters continue to occupy time and space.
Rest, meals, recreation and conversation consume time and may be interrupted by duty/emergency events.
Quarters assignment is residency state, not proof of relationship or family status.
Shared quarters or social space do not automatically create friendship, romance or private knowledge.
Alert and casualty states may preempt normal activity and change accessible locations.
Shipboard life uses the same persistent characters, memories, relationships and schedules as operational gameplay.
A character cannot simultaneously be on duty at a station and in private off-duty activity elsewhere.
NPC routines continue off-screen at appropriate LOD without inventing major life events.
AI may describe shipboard life from resolved state but cannot teleport characters or create facilities/services the ship lacks.
